books.title: Like a Love Story
books.author: Abdi Nazemian
books.description: Set in 1989 NYC during the AIDS crisis, three teens navigate love, activism, fear, and identity in a deeply emotional, historically grounded queer coming-of-age story.
books.review: Widely praised for its heart, urgency, and authentic portrayal of queer history.

books.title: Everything Sad Is Untrue (a True Story)
books.author: Daniel Nayeri
books.description: A refugee storyteller blends myth, memory, and humor to reclaim his narrative after fleeing Iran.
books.review: Frequently cited as powerful, inventive, and unforgettable.

books.title: The Stars Beneath Our Feet
books.author: David Barclay Moore
books.description: A boy grieving his brother’s death finds purpose and safety through creativity and community in Harlem.
books.review: Highly regarded for emotional depth and hopeful realism.

books.title: SLAY
books.author: Brittney Morris
books.description: A Black teen secretly creates an online game celebrating Black culture and must defend it when it goes viral.
books.review: Celebrated for its originality, cultural commentary, and fast pacing.

books.title: A Darker Mischief
books.author: Derek Milman
books.description: A queer dark-academia thriller about privilege, secret societies, and the cost of belonging.
books.review: Often compared to The Secret History with a sharper, modern edge.

books.title: Dear Haiti, Love Alaine
books.author: Maika Moulite & Maritza Moulite
books.description: A funny, heartfelt exploration of heritage, family secrets, and self-discovery set partly in Haiti.
books.review: Readers love its voice, humor, and cultural depth.

books.title: All Out: The No-Longer-Secret Stories of Queer Teens
books.author: Saundra Mitchell (editor)
books.description: A historical fiction anthology spotlighting queer teens across time, cultures, and identities.
books.review: Frequently praised for range, representation, and literary quality.

books.title: The Chandler Legacies
books.author: Abdi Nazemian
books.description: Five teens challenge abuse and silence at an elite boarding school through friendship and writing.
books.review: Admired for its moral weight and ensemble storytelling.

books.title: Ramona Blue
books.author: Julie Murphy
books.description: A Southern teen navigates family responsibility, attraction, and fluid sexuality.
books.review: Readers appreciate its honesty and emotional nuance.

books.title: Dumplin’
books.author: Julie Murphy
books.description: A body-positive, confidence-driven story about reclaiming self-worth in a beauty-pageant town.
books.review: Beloved for its empowering message and charm.

books.title: Pumpkin
books.author: Julie Murphy
books.description: A flamboyant, joyful prom-court rebellion led by a fat, gay teen in West Texas.
books.review: Celebrated for humor, inclusivity, and heart.

books.title: Puddin’
books.author: Julie Murphy
books.description: Two unlikely girls form a friendship that challenges popularity, body image, and expectations.
books.review: Often noted as a strong companion to Dumplin’.

books.title: Beating Heart Baby
books.author: Lio Min
books.description: An indie-music-infused friends-to-lovers story about identity and second chances.

books.title: Gone, Gone, Gone
books.author: Hannah Moskowitz
books.description: A queer romance unfolding during the DC sniper shootings, blending fear and intimacy.
books.review: Praised for atmosphere and emotional tension.

books.title: What Makes Us
books.author: Rafi Mittlefehldt
books.description: A teen activist confronts family history and public prejudice after a viral moment.

books.title: Trigger
books.author: C.G. Moore
books.description: A verse novel exploring trauma, memory, and justice after sexual assault.
books.review: Heavy but respected for its honesty.

books.title: Jump
books.author: Brittney Morris
books.description: Four teens join a dangerous contest to save their city from environmental collapse.

books.title: Kill the Boy Band
books.author: Goldy Moldavsky
books.description: A darkly comedic satire of fandom obsession gone wrong.

books.title: A Cuban Girl’s Guide to Tea and Tomorrow
books.author: Laura Taylor Namey
books.description: A Miami teen heals after heartbreak during an unexpected summer in England.

books.title: When We Were Them
books.author: Laura Taylor Namey
books.description: A fractured friendship is revisited through memories and regret.

books.title: With Love, Echo Park
books.author: Laura Taylor Namey
books.description: Two teens clash over community change while confronting shared history.

books.title: Willa and the Whale
books.author: Chad Morris & Shelly Brown
books.description: A grieving girl discovers she can communicate with whales.

books.title: All That It Ever Meant
books.author: Blessing Musariri
books.description: A road trip haunted by grief, memory, and ancestral voices.

books.title: Just Say Yes
books.author: Goldy Moldavsky
books.description: A chaotic party-driven spiral exploring consent and peer pressure.

books.title: Just Until
books.author: Joseph Moldover
books.description: A teen must decide whether to give up her future to care for family.

books.title: The Legend
books.author: Jean Mills
books.description: A hockey-centered coming-of-age story about injury, mentorship, and trust.

books.title: l8r, g8r
books.author: Lauren Myracle
books.description: Instant-message storytelling following friendship drama in senior year.

books.title: ttyl
books.author: Lauren Myracle
books.description: Three teens navigate high school entirely through chat logs.

books.title: Thirty Talks Weird Love
books.author: Alessandra Narváez Varela
books.description: A verse novel about self-acceptance through conversations with a future self.
